newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system on Friday via overnight system repurchase agreements, as federal funds were seen under pressure.

Fed funds were trading at 5-3/4 percent in early trading, above the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target. Analysts cited the settlement of last week's Treasury refunding auctions as contributing to the tight funds rate.

On Thursday, the Fed added $6.4 billion in reserves through a round of seven-day fixed system RPs. Some noted that large size suggested the Fed was willing to get ahead of its add job and front-load the week with reserves to try and contain funds pressure ahead of the auction settlements.
